scientific_integrity: The result is an exact mathematical conditional statement about a stated model; earlier vulnerable-vertex and random-network cascade results are acknowledged. Self-review is not external validation.
scientific_limitations: Inclusive half-threshold, finite connected trees, one uniformly sampled seed, monotone irreversible activation; no assertion for cycles, heterogeneous thresholds, independent edge transmission or empirical behavior. The fully general proof is analytical; finite simulations are corroboration only. Literature-wide novelty and independent validation remain unestablished.
title: Sharp minimum mean majority-threshold cascade on finite social trees
